# Goodreads

> Goodreads is a social platform for discovering, sharing, and discussing books across diverse genres with personalized recommendations and reading challenges.

Goodreads connects millions of readers through book discovery, ratings, reviews, and community features. The platform supports browsing across numerous genres including fiction, nonfiction, classics, children's books, and specialized categories like business and biography.

## Key Topics

- Book recommendations
- Book discovery
- Genre browsing
- Reading challenges
- User authentication
- Book giveaways
- New releases
- User accounts
- Social reading
- Literary classics
- Goodreads LLC
- Amazon integration
- Single sign-on (SSO)
- Book ratings and reviews
- Reading community

## Authentication & Account

- [Sign in](https://www.goodreads.com/user/sign_in): Goodreads authentication with Amazon, Google, and Apple SSO
- [Goodreads Sign in](https://www.goodreads.com/challenges/11680): Goodreads login page with password reset and account access

## Genre Browsing & Discovery

- [Art Books](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/art): Browse Art genre books with new releases and recommendations
- [Biography Books](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/biography): Browse Biography genre with new releases and popular titles
- [Business Books](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/business): Browse Business genre with leadership and productivity books
- [Childrens Books](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/children-s): Browse Children's books with illustrated stories and giveaways
- [Christian Books](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/christian): Browse Christian fiction and living books with recommendations
- [Classics Books](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/classics): Browse literary classics including Orwell, Fitzgerald, Morrison

## Legal & Policies

- [Terms of Use](https://www.goodreads.com/about/terms): Goodreads LLC terms of service and user responsibilities
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.goodreads.com/about/privacy): Goodreads LLC data collection and privacy practices
